# Example Docs

Example Inc builds Example, a toolkit for widgets. It runs in any browser and on the server, and these docs cover installing it, configuring it and the options most teams change first.

- Install
  - macOS
  - Linux
- Configure

Read the [guide](https://example.com/guide/), see [pricing](https://example.com/pricing/), or the [old page](https://example.com/nope/).

# Guide

Updated November 1, 2026.

## How do I install it?

```sh
npm install example
```

## Options

| Key   | Default |
| ----- | ------- |
| size  | 10      |
| color | blue    |

Next: [advanced](https://example.com/guide/advanced/).

# Advanced

Built from 0123abcd by the docs team.

Advanced users of Example can tune the widget cache, swap the renderer and plug in their own storage backend. Each of these is a single option in the configuration file described in the guide.

Back to the [guide](https://example.com/guide/).

# Pricing

Example is free for everyone.

There are no paid tiers, no usage limits and no account to create. Companies that want a support contract can talk to Example Inc, which answers within one business day and keeps the toolkit itself free.
